Karnataka Minister Promises Strict Investigation into KPSC Irregularities

Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge has assured a "no nonsense" investigation into irregularities within the Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC). The probe involves arrests, searches, and scrutiny of examination records and financial transactions. Allegations involve both candidates and officials in the recruitment process.
